entities.summary: Igor Magogin is a Russian former professional ice hockey centre who last played for HC 07 Detva of the Slovak Extraliga. Magogin joined Severstal Cherepovets as a free agent on a one-year contract on May 3, 2016, after spending one season with HC Lada Togliatti.
